source_differences: Record locality Kobarid: damage was mainly in Čezsoča and Bovec (also Soča, Mala vas, Kal-Koritnica), all in Bovec municipality, per ARSO (Vidrih, Ujma) and EMSC. USGS-derived EarthquakeTrack says '0.0 km from Kobarid', but the ARSO epicentre 46.32N 13.63E is the Krn/Bovec area, ~8 km NE of Kobarid.
Magnitude differs: ARSO ML 4.9. EMSC title mb 5.1. USGS Mwc 5.2. One EGU abstract says 5.5.
Magnitude of 12 July 2004: Potres z magnitudo 4,9 (ARSO, Ujma) (ojs-gr.zrc-sazu.si) against Navorna magnituda potresa je bila 5,2 (ARSO map sheet). EMSC title says mb 5.1 (potresi.arso.gov.si)
Depth: okoli 8 km (ARSO) (ojs-gr.zrc-sazu.si) against Depth: 7.0 km (earthquaketrack, USGS-derived) (earthquaketrack.com)
